translated:
You're going to save Odin, right?
I want no part of that job.
It's been rumor for a while.

For humans, it's certain things are better
without a guy like that...

So you two finally got made into
einherjar too...
This isn't a problem you can fix with an apology!

If killing me here and now would clear your anger,
that's fine too.
It's because nothing happened that I'm like this.

Until now I endured thinking I was a mercenary of the gods,
but einherjar are just errand runners.

But there's one piece of good news.
Odin seems to have been taken away by someone.
I know. It was Lezard's doing.

It's not that simple.
He is hiding something from us.

I don't quite understand, but...
something very big.

Right when we were fighting Odin,
he snatched him away from the side.
You fought Odin with just the two of you?
I've come to truly hate myself...

Then become our mercenary.
Though we can't pay you.

Will you search for the Dragon Orb
with us?
I hear Midgard is in pretty bad shape.
